threshold_inference.today_minimum: nonmonotone first/all upcrossings, not-reached and finite-grid confidence candidates using existing frozen curve
threshold_inference.bias_corrected_pilot_math: L local-linear row, C2 local-cubic normalized-coordinate quadratic coefficient row, c=sum_i L_i(D_i-a)^2, W=L-c*C2/b^2. W reproduces constants and lines and removes quadratic bias exactly in a full-rank design. This finite-design adaptation is not claimed as a full Takatsu-Westling theorem reproduction.
threshold_inference.conditional_band: Use one multiplier per original user across all query values. With frozen pseudo-outcomes and nuisance fits this is a conditional finite-grid sampling band, not full-chain uncertainty.
threshold_inference.publication_theory_requirement: Primary qkae041 formula/theorem, boundary and bias estimation, nuisance estimation and repeated-user adaptation all need separate verification before claiming published coverage guarantees
